Answer: B
Reason: The initial radiograph (Figure 1) displays vertical lucent streaks along the mediastinal borders (arrows), characteristic of pneumomediastinum, and the clinical history notes subcutaneous emphysema. The follow-up radiograph (Figure 4) taken ten days later shows a normal chest with complete resolution of these extra-alveolar air findings, consistent with the benign, self-limiting nature of spontaneous pneumomediastinum.
